Name: Pirate Furniture and Decorations for Content Patcher
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Pirate Furniture and Decorations for Content Patcher
[/b][/size][size=3]A Pirate's life for you! Decorate to your heart's content with more piratey furniture, wallpaper and flooring. Adds over 60 unique decor items and 15 walls and floors. [/size]

[b][size=5]New in version 2.0:[/size][/b]
[size=3]All items are now separated into the [b]Pirate Catalog[/b]. Purchase the Pirate Furniture Catalog from Willy's Shop, or spawn it in with CJB.  [/size]


[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Content Patcher
Calcifer[/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds 60+ new furniture items, including Pirate bed, cannon, parrot, barrels, ale, swords and skulls [/size]
[*][size=3]Version 1.0: Adds items to the Vanilla catalogs[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 2.0: Adds a dedicated "Pirate Catalog" that you can buy from Willy's shop[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with Happy Home Designer[/size]
[*][size=3]All pixel-art is based off of vanilla game sprites[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Looking for an Alternative Textures (AT) Version?
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25076]Grab it here[/url]
